description: This file defines the EducationService class, which provides business logic functions for managing educational qualifications within the OrangeHRM system. It interfaces with the EducationDao for data persistence operations such as save, retrieve, delete, and validation of education records.

classes.name: EducationService
classes.description: Provides methods for managing education entities, including saving, retrieving, deleting, and validation, encapsulating business logic and interacting with the data access object (DAO).

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Saves an Education object; can create a new record or update an existing one.

methods.name: getEducationDao
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of EducationDao, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: setEducationDao
methods.description: Sets the EducationDao instance, enabling dependency injection.

methods.name: getEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves an Education object by its ID.

methods.name: getEducationByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Education object by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getEducationList
methods.description: Returns a list of Education objects based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEducationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Education objects matching the search filter.

methods.name: deleteEducations
methods.description: Deletes education records by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingEducationName
methods.description: Checks if an education name already exists, case-insensitive.
